paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin for previewing 3D models, supporting FBX, OBJ, glTF/GLB, and
STL files · DSH 3D 模型查看器
3D Viewer
English | 中文
[](https://github.com/ybniaobu/dsh-3d-viewer) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-3d-viewer?activeT
/github.com/ybniaobu/dsh-3d-viewer) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-3d-viewer?activeTab=readme)
Preview FBX, OBJ, glTF, GLB, and STL models plus TGA, EXR, and HDR textures from the current session
's workspace in DSH's right sidebar. Open a model, orbit, zoom, auto-rotate, switch materials and en
vironments, and play embedded animations.
## Installation and enabling
Distributed as the npm package `dsh-3d-viewer`. The prebuilt `dist/client.js` contains the viewer an
d Three.js core; model loaders and TGA, EXR, and HDR decoders are package-local lazy chunks fetched
only on first use. The four HDRI files ship in the package and are served by a small read-only host
route on the local DSH server. React comes from DSH.
### Install from npm (recommended)

1. Open DSH Desktop and choose **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** → **Install a thi

rd-party plugin**.
3. Enter `dsh-3d-viewer` (or `dsh-3d-viewer@0.2.1` to pin a version).
4. Set **Re

gistry** to the official npm registry (npmmirror also works in mainland China).
5. Click **Install**
, then confirm **3D Viewer** is **On** under **Installed plugins**.
> **Updating**: remove the old version under **Plugins**, then install the new one with a higher ver
pdating**: remove the old version under **Plugins**, then install the new one with a higher version.
### Install from a local directory (optional)
Use this for offline or intranet distribution.
1. Unpack the plugin directory anywhere; it must contain `package.json`, `dist/client.js` plus its c

hunks, `index.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`, and the `assets/hdri/` directory.
2. Open DSH Desktop and cho

ose **Plugins** in the sidebar.
3. Click **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**.
4. Enter

the directory's absolute path (for example `F:\plugins\dsh-3d-viewer`) and click **Install**.
5. Co
nfirm **3D Viewer** is **On** under **Installed plugins**.
> Local installs link to the directory rather than copying it. Do not move, rename, or delete it, or

DSH may not find the plugin on the next start.
>
> Plugins run inside the DSH process; install only

the plugin on the next start.
>
> Plugins run inside the DSH process; install only trusted sources.
### Requirements

- DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer (built and tested on 0.2.2-rc.1).
- WebGL 2 support; otherwise the

preview reports an error.
- Model and texture files in the session workspace, reachable through **F
iles** in the right sidebar.
## Open a model or texture
In any session, open the right sidebar, then **Files** (`Mod+P`), and click an `.fbx`, `.obj`, `.glt
f`, `.glb`, `.stl`, `.tga`, `.exr`, or `.hdr` file. It opens in a preview tab; large files and the f
irst environment switch may take a few seconds.
If no preview appears, refresh the page; if it still does not, restart DSH.
## Supported formats
| Format | Support |

| **FBX** | Meshes, hierarchy, materials, embedded textures, animations, and node data |
| **OBJ** |
Polygons, `o`/`g` groups, normals, UVs, vertex colors, line/point primitives, `mtllib`/MTL, and com

mon textures |
| **glTF, GLB** | Animations, skinning, embedded resources, and external `.bin` files

and textures |
| **STL** | ASCII and binary STL; neutral double-sided PBR material; binary vertex c

olors preserved |
| **TGA, EXR, HDR** | Standalone texture previews and sidecar textures for FBX and
OBJ; see Texture previews |
External resources (FBX and glTF textures, glTF `.bin`, OBJ MTL and textures) are read from the sess
rces (FBX and glTF textures, glTF `.bin`, OBJ MTL and textures) are read from the session workspace.
Notes:
- **All formats**: lights, cameras, and audio embedded in the file are ignored; FBX skips camera/lig

ht construction during parsing, and the preview uses its own lighting and camera.
- The 3D canvas us
es Blender's default viewport tones (`#f8f8f8` light, `#303030` dark), selected from the current DSH

appearance.
- **FBX**: a missing external texture warns but does not block geometry.
- **FBX and OB
J**: sidecar texture loading overlaps geometry parsing; the view is revealed after both finish (or a

fter the texture settle timeout).
- **OBJ**: a missing MTL falls back to default materials; missing

textures use white placeholders.
- **glTF, GLB**: resources shared by several primitives are read on

ce.
- **STL**: no materials or animations.
### Texture previews
TGA, EXR, and HDR files can be opened directly from **Files**. The same decoders are used for extern
al FBX and OBJ texture references.
| Format | Decoded data | Preview behavior |

| **TGA** | 8-bit RGBA (RGBA8) | Pixel data is shown directly; alpha is preserved. |
| **EXR** | 16-
bit half float or 32-bit float, 1–4 channels | Linear HDR data is tone-mapped to SDR for display. |
| **HDR** | Radiance RGBE, decoded to 16-bit half float by default | Linear HDR data is tone-mapped
to SDR for display. |
- EXR and HDR previews use exposure 1 and Reinhard tone mapping before sRGB output; material renderi

ng keeps the linear values.
- The metadata badge shows dimensions, per-channel bit depth, and the cu

rrent zoom percentage.
- Direct previews support wheel zoom, drag-to-pan when zoomed, **Fit** / doub

le-click reset, and **Flip Y** for bottom-up sources.
- Decoder chunks are fetched only on first use

; opening a PNG or JPEG, or a model that never uses TGA, EXR, or HDR, does not download them.
- EXR
and HDR previews and model sidecars decode in up to two lazy workers when the browser allows Blob wo
rkers; low-memory or four-core-or-fewer devices use one worker, and blocked workers fall back to the

main thread.
- HDR previews use a WebGL2 tone-mapping pass when available, with a half-float LUT fa

llback for blocked or unsupported WebGL contexts.
- Preview results are cached by resource address,
file version, and format: 160 MiB LRU on normal devices, 64 MiB on devices reporting 4 GB or less. R

eopening an unchanged texture skips worker decode and GPU conversion.
- Closing a preview aborts its

worker request; a worker with no outstanding work is terminated and recreated on demand.
- Material
sidecar buffers are transferred to the worker without the extra copy; preview buffers are copied be

cause the document read cache can share them.
